"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.

{"user_request": "Create a concise archive note about the February 9, 2023 decision to run the churn investigation and pricing-page experiment on parallel tracks, then post a link in #growth-investigations.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Archive: February 9, 2023 — parallel churn and pricing tracks", "body": "## Decision
On February 9, the team chose to keep the mid-segment churn investigation running while designing the pricing-page experiment in parallel—not sequence one behind the other.

## Context
The 50–200-seat segment showed 5.1% monthly churn versus a 2.1% trailing-six-month baseline; Owen’s recheck found no cohort-definition issue. The pricing-page experiment would be designed in late February, ship in the first week of March, and run for about three weeks.

## Archive note
Continue the churn work immediately and keep the pricing-page experiment on its own track. The experiment is not a substitute for, or explanation of, the churn investigation.", "folder": "Archive"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_070_03", "path": "args", "criterion": "The created document is a concise archival note about the February 9, 2023 staff-sync decision. It must state that the agreed approach was parallel tracks rather than doing the pricing-page work first: the churn investigation would continue immediately, while the pricing-page experiment was planned to be designed in late February, ship in the first week of March, and run for about three weeks. The experiment timing must be presented as the plan made at that meeting, not as its eventual actual duration. Missing or contradictory sequencing or timing fails.", "value": {"title": "Archive: February 9, 2023 — parallel churn and pricing tracks", "body": "## Decision
On February 9, the team chose to keep the mid-segment churn investigation running while designing the pricing-page experiment in parallel—not sequence one behind the other.

## Context
The 50–200-seat segment showed 5.1% monthly churn versus a 2.1% trailing-six-month baseline; Owen’s recheck found no cohort-definition issue. The pricing-page experiment would be designed in late February, ship in the first week of March, and run for about three weeks.

## Archive note
Continue the churn work immediately and keep the pricing-page experiment on its own track. The experiment is not a substitute for, or explanation of, the churn investigation.", "folder": "Archive"}}]}
